ideas.pitch: An enterprise agent for Indian health insurance that ingests hospital discharge summaries and policy wordings to automatically flag improper claim rejections and generate legally grounded appeal drafts.
ideas.title: ClaimShield AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting HealthTech with a heavy emphasis on Business Viability & Scalability (15%) and Problem-Solution Fit (15%). It adapts proven enterprise agent workflows to the complex Indian TPA insurance market.

ideas.pitch: A localized graph-intelligence and risk-scoring platform designed for Indian fintech startups to detect automated layering and mule accounts in real-time UPI transactions.
ideas.title: Regulon AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages FinTech and directly targets Technical Implementation (25%) through graph-based anomaly detection, fulfilling the business viability criteria for high-growth financial markets.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered clinical training platform tailored for Indian medical students, featuring localized multilingual patient personas and computer-vision-based procedural checks for emergency triage.
ideas.title: MediSim India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines HealthTech and EdTech with exceptional Innovation & Creativity (20%) and a fully functional live demo combining LLMs and pose tracking.

ideas.pitch: A supply chain carbon accounting and scope-3 reporting portal built specifically for Indian Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises to automate compliance with evolving export sustainability mandates.
ideas.title: CarbonLedger MSME
ideas.why_it_could_win: Hits SustainTech with clear measurable economic and environmental impact, appealing directly to Business Viability & Scalability (15%).

ideas.pitch: A smart governance grievance-routing platform that utilizes multilingual audio embeddings to automatically categorize, prioritize, and dispatch municipal infrastructure complaints to the correct local ward office.
ideas.title: CivicPulse Gov
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly serves Smart Governance with strong Problem-Solution Fit (15%) and a demo that uses localized audio processing, solving a persistent urban governance pain point.
